issue.title: Expand @attachment:<bead>/<name> in prompts and allow cross-bead attachment reuse

task_type_fields.proposal: Let the prompt @-reference pipeline expand attachment:<bead-id>/<name> refs. They would materialize the extension-preserving view path, or fetch it from the private store, so agents receive the file. Also let a note on one bead reuse another bead's attachment by digest without re-ingesting it.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ck registered the attachment artifact-ref kind only for sase artifact path/open/read and pager links. Its grammar limits @attachment:<name> reuse to the same bead roster. Prompt expansion and cross-bead reuse are new surfaces outside the epic plan.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1ck.10 (ga phase of epic sase-1ck) proposed this follow-up, and the epic plan listed it as one. Attachment refs currently resolve only for viewing, not in agent prompts or on other beads.
